description: Read a saved site's latest availability check, response time in milliseconds, uptime percentages over 24 hours and 30 days, and any ongoing incident. Does not probe the site now or start monitoring. If lastCheckedAt is null, no check exists: the default currentStatus is not evidence that the site is up. Null percentages mean no measurements. Use audit_url or run_audit to measure page speed instead.

siteId.description: Saved site ID from list_sites; not a URL
